title_en: Technology and Engineering (15/20): Inspecting a Car's Undercarriage
note_en: 才 after a time clause means "only then, not before": 检查全部完成后，汽车才会被放下来 "only after the whole inspection is done will the car be lowered." English needs "only... then" or "not until," but Chinese simply puts 才 before the verb; paired with 只有 it stresses the condition even more: 只有举升机把车升到所需高度后，机械锁才会启动 "only once the lift has raised the car to the required height does the mechanical lock engage."
